segments.contextBefore: Memory Allocation
segments.contextAfter: The system memory allocator `free` operation zeroes out all deallocated blocks in iOS 16.1 beta or later. Invalid accesses to free memory might result in new crashes or corruption, including: - Read-after-free bugs that previously observed the old contents of a block may now observe zeroes instead

segments.source: The system memory allocator `free` operation zeroes out all deallocated blocks in iOS 16.1 beta or later. Invalid accesses to free memory might result in new crashes or corruption, including: - Read-after-free bugs that previously observed the old contents of a block may now observe zeroes instead
segments.normalizedSource: The system memory allocator `free` operation zeroes out all deallocated blocks in iOS 16.1 beta or later. Invalid accesses to free memory might result in new crashes or corruption, including: - Read-after-free bugs that previously observed the old contents of a block may now observe zeroes instead
segments.contextBefore: Known Issues
